appDescription: A driving companion that adjusts the cabin climate to keep the driver calm and alert.

function.name: ADJUST_CABIN_COMFORT
function.description: Undo or stop the cabin climate change that this app made when the driver feels too cold or wants it to stop.

feeling.description: Whether the driver feels too cold or wants the app to stop adjusting the climate.

function.name: ANSWER_REST_SUGGESTION
function.description: Answer the app's suggestion to take a break at the upcoming rest area on the route.

accept.description: True if the driver wants to stop at the suggested rest area.
